analysis:
Integration of 8 units. The PR changes only docs, a changelog, a submodule pointer and an opt-in live test. The changed docs are changelog.d/ssd-restore-without-eval-lock.md, docs/architecture/inference.md (head 253-259), docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md (head 784-790), docs/developer/test.md (new ModelCheckpointRestoreContentionLiveTests section) and docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md (head 119). The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule moves 14661d9 to c17693f, and a live test file is added. No executable provider source diff is supplied, so no regression is evidenced and no finding is raised.

Documented behavior change (T-041, TB-007, A-001): provider-staged complete-checkpoint imports now create destinations already available from zeroed host bytes. They skip eval and stream fences, so SSD staging no longer waits on MLX's process-wide evalLock. The import plan charges the largest destination as staging scratch. Native-bound imports keep device allocation. DBK3 crypto, HMAC lookup tags, 30-minute TTL, salt scoping and disk budget are not described as changed, so T-041 at-rest posture and the SEC-035 accepted TTFT oracle are unchanged in kind. Reduced lock contention might shift TTFT timing, but that is speculative.

Unverified, since the implementing sources are outside the evidence: CheckpointHostZeros.swift, CompleteCheckpointTransfer.swift, PagedCheckpointStorage.swift, CompleteCheckpointImportPlan.swift and the mlx-swift-lm submodule diff. The next pass should check: (1) whole-file GCM/AAD and weightHash/layoutEpoch/salt validation completes before any destination is usable; (2) zeroed destinations are fully overwritten, so no partial or cross-tenant KV can be read (T-028); (3) the scratch charge through GlobalKVCacheBudget is released on all paths (SSDPrefixCache.endAdoption/completeStaging, EngineV2Bridge backstops); (4) host plaintext KV is not retained after import.

The live test is opt-in, uses an isolated ephemeral cache and a scrubbed environment, and writes timings only. It does not weaken production controls. No threat-model update is required from this evidence. needs_deeper_review is set only for the unseen code and submodule diff.
